notes: Adds reliable keyboard Done handling and explicit keyboard dismissal for every Speedtest+ controls action while retaining the original blue-leading, gray-following gauge animation, all profiles/themes/results features, and the full finite non-negative custom-speed range.

ios.notes: Keeps native iOS setup Continue unobstructed by waiting for any visible setup action to finish before installing Speedtest+ overlays, delays update checks until setup settles, and adds a privacy-safe connection health action. Provider/server selection and remote submission remain untouched. This IPA is unsigned and must be signed before sideloading.
